mostWorthwhile.text: Making the muscle precursor cells was most worthwhile: the planned pictures contrast retained muscle proteins with exported collagen and connect both outcomes to different RNA messages from the same DNA.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final tissue combination was a little repetitive: the matrix picture already showed living fibroblasts beside the material they produced, so it was not obvious why a separate combination was needed.

surprise.text: The supporting-tissue goal remained incomplete after collagen fibres were assembled beside living fibroblasts; it took one more combination to establish their arrangement as tissue.

arbitrary.text: That last combination felt somewhat arbitrary because the preceding picture already included both fibroblasts and matrix, although the result added cell–matrix attachments and a connected tissue arrangement.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the separate myoblasts develop into muscle fibres; their preparation leaves that process open.
